# `flagMedicalHold`

**Kind:** function tool — a question Grace waits on
**Source model:** `grace_contracts.tools.escalation_tools.FlagMedicalHoldInput`
**Generated JSON:** `platform/vapi/tools/flagMedicalHold.json`

## What it does, and when Grace calls it

Call this the instant a caller mentions surgery, an injury, a condition, medication, pregnancy, or any treatment — even in passing. It blocks the booking so a qualified person can follow up. Do NOT ask what the condition is, do NOT repeat it back, and do NOT record it anywhere. After calling this, escalate.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type / allowed values | Required | Default | What it means |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `disclosed` | `boolean` | **yes** | — | Always pass true. Call this the moment a caller mentions surgery, treatment, or any health matter. Do NOT ask what it is, and do NOT describe it anywhere. |

Any parameter not listed above is **rejected**, not ignored — the model inventing a field must be a loud error, never silent.
